text_block_list.text:
...And so, that race arrived once again 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Putting everything on the line, here 
comes the final stretch of the Nippon 
Derby!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente charges up in a flash from 
behind!! What incredible acceleration!! 
She surges into the lead on the uphill 
stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente in the lead! Duramente takes the 
lead! She is simply too strong!! She broke 
away in the blink of an eye!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Duramente! She claims the Double Crown!!!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh... I couldn't reach him...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Fantastica...! What a magnificent 
race...!

This year's Nippon Derby was once again an 
incredible race, where the Umamusume 
clashed with everything they had...!

Together with Sounds of Earth, my heart 
raced with excitement imagining the kind 
of races she could run with them in the 
future, but—
...The news came without warning.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Duramente broke a bone... Are you 
serious...!? No way... That's so 
devastating...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to seeing whether 
it'd be the Kikuka Sho or the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—It is a sadness so profound it could tear 
one apart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Earth-san...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's not just sorrow. This sound 
is... frustration.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...You mean Duramente-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Amazing... You see right through 
everything, don't you...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true. I only know what I can 
hear. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like... would you mind telling me 
what it is that troubles you so?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Such a sorrowful melody does not suit you. 
Kitasan Black—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Um... There's an Umamusume that I really 
look up to.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Strong... cool... and sparkling."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
With a run like a miracle, move everyone 
watching... and move me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I realized that's what I wanted to become.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become a star Umamusume like 
that too... making everyone's hearts burn 
hot like a festival."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Entering Tracen Academy, giving it 
everything I had, and finally earning the 
chance to run in the Classic races...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"This is it. I'm finally gonna become just 
like the one I've always looked up to... 
Or at least, that's what I thought—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—It was far away. I was made to realize 
that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A real... star Umamusume is... someone 
like Duramente-san...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still... even so...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't just give up...! So I switched 
gears, determined to get my revenge at the 
Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I thought 'next time'... and yet— 
Duramente-san is... injured...—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...You wanted to beat Duramente head-on, 
didn't you? That's what you were aiming 
for.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: But now, I've... lost sight of that goal.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, isn't there only one thing 
to do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If you've lost sight of your goal, why not 
just make a new one? For example—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Winning the races ahead, winning again and 
again to prove your strength. ...Something 
along those lines.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
By continuing to win, I'll prove who's 
stronger than Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To everyone watching... and to Duramente 
herself!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
However, that is by no means an easy feat. 
As you know well, Duramente-san is 
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To prove that you're stronger than her, 
you'd need results momentous enough to 
shake the very course of history.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"You are an Umamusume who can take on such 
hardships. I truly believe that."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Why, that's...――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? 'I can only 
understand what I can hear.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
For I have already heard your inner 
melody.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—I've said a lot of things, but in the 
end, deciding what to do is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I, for one, am looking forward to it. To 
Kitasan Black letting the festival music 
ring out come autumn, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Until next time, then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh... It's no good...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate... there's no way I can 
catch up...—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —May I wipe away those tears?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, Earth-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You must not push yourself too hard. Right 
now, the weight of your sorrow is just a 
bit too heavy.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
First, why don't you have a warm drink 
with me and calm down a bit?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I just can't calm down.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm... the only one right now... who's 
fallen so far behind...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
While everyone else is dashing up their 
own paths... I'm still... not even 
standing on the same stage—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "And I…… could do nothing but watch……――"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: It was so... unbearable frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I...! Even though I'm this 
frustrated, I...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I haven't gotten stronger at all...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Standing before a stronger light, one's 
shadow only appears darker.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I feared that if this continued, I might 
simply fade away into that brilliance—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I completely understand why you feel so 
rushed.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—Our generation could never help but be 
conscious of the previous generation's 
wonderfully brilliant Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There were certainly many who compared 
themselves to those girls and lamented the 
gap between them. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I know someone who believed in 
herself, kept training relentlessly, and 
showed the world her brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... you can do the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's just...! That Umamusume must have 
just worked super hard, but as for me...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I CAN DO ITTTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Because you carry a frustration stronger 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
With that frustration in her heart, the 
will to change herself remains alive even 
now.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It is not something anyone can do. To 
recognize one's own weakness, to feel 
remorse, sometimes anger, and to possess 
the heart to change—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—That is Cheval Grand. That distinct, 
irreplaceable sound that belongs only to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's a "strength" that belongs to you and 
you alone.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Just... for me...—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Even if you lack confidence in yourself, I 
know the sound that comes from you. And I 
believe in it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"So please, don't be too hard on yourself— 
and just try to take it one step at a 
time."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Tread your own magnificent path.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(...I've done all I can for now. All 
that's left is for me to pursue my own 
path—)

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
“—I hear you've been messing with all 
sorts of Umamusume again?”

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
And this time with the younger generation, 
no less. I have to admire how broad your 
reach is.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Both of you...—

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"I can read your intentions, Earth-kun. 
Laying the groundwork for the future, are 
we?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can't compete with that. To think 
you understood me so thoroughly—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"Then you'll tell us, right? Let us in on 
your plan too, Earth."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Japan Cup' and the 'Arima Kinen.' 
There, I will create the greatest music we 
can make right now, spanning across 
generations."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Will you strive for it with me? As our 
'unrivaled generation playing a brilliant 
melody.'

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you make it sound so simple! 
—Of course I'll aim for it!!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to repay my debt to 
Earth soon anyway. It's a good 
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie, my beloved friend...!!

—Little by little, heading toward 
autumn... everyone's feelings begin to 
converge.

All to compose a magnificent piece of 
music that no one has ever heard before—
